title.en: Chemical engineering calculations and calculation basis

h.en: Chemical engineering calculations and calculation basis

body.en:
Definition

Chemical engineering calculations apply units, property relations and conservation laws to quantify process streams and operations.

Explanation and use

  • Choose a basis such as100kg solution, 1kmol gas or1hour of steady operation.Label each stream and unknown before equations.
  • Convert all data to compatible units; keep mass, moles and volume distinct.State dry/wet basis, temperature, pressure and composition basis.
  • Write independent balances, solve algebraically, substitute values and report units.Check mass closure and sensible signs/ranges.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Process streams/operationsને units, property relations તથા conservation lawsથી સંખ્યાત્મક રીતે સમજવી એટલે chemical engineering calculations.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • 100kg solution, 1kmol gas કે steady operationના1hour જેવા basis પસંદ કરો.Equations પહેલાં streams/unknowns લખો.
  • Data compatible unitsમાં ફેરવો; mass, moles/volume જુદાં રાખો.Dry/wet basis, T, P/composition basis લખો.
  • Independent balances લખી algebraથી ઉકેલી values મૂકો; units આપો.Mass closure તથા signs/ranges તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

A dimension describes the physical nature of a quantity; a unit is a chosen magnitude used to express its numerical value.

Classification / basis

  • SI has seven base quantities:length m, mass kg, time s, temperature K, amount mol, electric current A, luminous intensity cd.
  • Derived quantities combine base dimensions:velocity LT⁻¹, density ML⁻³, force MLT⁻², pressure ML⁻¹T⁻².
  • MKS uses metre, kilogram, second; absolute SI force is newton.FPS commonly uses foot, pound-mass, second; distinguish lbm from lbf and use a consistent force convention.
  • Gravitational engineering units use kgf or lbf:1kgf=9.80665N, 1lbf=4.4482216N.FPS absolute force may instead be poundal; these names are not interchangeable.

Base SI quantities

QuantitySymbol / unit
Lengthm
Masskg

Thermodynamic temperatureK
Amount of substancemol
Electric currentA
Luminous intensitycd

FPS force convention

For lbm, lbf, ft, s use F=ma/gc, with gc≈32.174lbm·ft/(lbf·s²).In absolute FPS with poundals, F=ma directly.Do not insert gc into an already coherent SI equation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Dimension quantityનો physical પ્રકાર બતાવે; unit તેનું numerical value દર્શાવવા પસંદ કરેલું માપ છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / આધાર

  • SIની7base quantities:length m, mass kg, time s, temperature K, amount mol, current A, luminous intensity cd.
  • Derived quantities base dimensionsથી બને:velocity LT⁻¹, density ML⁻³, force MLT⁻², pressure ML⁻¹T⁻².
  • MKS metre, kilogram, second વાપરે; absolute SI force newton.FPSમાં foot, pound-mass, second; lbm/lbf જુદાં રાખી consistent convention લો.
  • Gravitational units kgf/lbf વાપરે:1kgf=9.80665N, 1lbf=4.4482216N.FPS absolute force poundal પણ હોય; આ નામો interchangeable નથી.

FPS Force Convention

Lbm, lbf, ft, sમાં F=ma/gc, gc≈32.174lbm·ft/(lbf·s²).Absolute FPS/poundalમાં F=ma સીધું.SI coherent equationમાં gc મૂકશો નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Force changes motion; volume measures occupied space; pressure is normal force per unit area.

Explanation and use

  • F=ma:dimension MLT⁻², SI N=kg·m/s².Volume V has L³, SI m³; 1L=10⁻³m³.
  • P=F/A:dimension ML⁻¹T⁻², SI Pa=N/m².The same pressure may be expressed in bar, kPa, atm or mmHg after proper conversion.
  • An absolute pressure is measured from perfect vacuum; a gauge pressure is relative to local atmosphere.Gas-law calculations require absolute pressure.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Force motion બદલે; volume occupied space માપે; pressure એટલે unit area દીઠ normal force.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • F=ma:MLT⁻², SI N=kg·m/s².Volume L³, SI m³; 1L=10⁻³m³.
  • P=F/A:ML⁻¹T⁻², SI Pa=N/m².Proper conversionથી bar, kPa, atm/mmHgમાં લખી શકાય.
  • Absolute pressure perfect vacuumથી, gauge local atmosphereથી માપાય.Gas lawમાં absolute pressure જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

Work and heat are modes of energy transfer; power is energy transferred per unit time.Heat is energy transferred because of temperature difference, not temperature itself.

Explanation and use

  • For a constant force along displacement, W=Fs; energy/work dimension ML²T⁻², SI J=N·m.
  • Power P=W/t:dimension ML²T⁻³, SI W=J/s.The symbol W for work and unit W for watt must be distinguished by context.
  • Heat Q is measured in J; 1thermochemical cal=4.184J, 1kcal=4184J.1kWh=3.6×10⁶J is energy, not power.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Work/heat energy transferની રીત છે; power energy/time છે.Temperature differenceથી transfer થતી energy heat છે, temperature પોતે નહીં.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Displacement directionમાં constant force માટે W=Fs; dimension ML²T⁻², SI J=N·m.
  • Power P=W/t:ML²T⁻³, SI W=J/s.Workનું symbol W અને watt unit W contextથી જુદાં ઓળખો.
  • Heat Q Jમાં; 1thermochemical cal=4.184J, 1kcal=4184J.1kWh=3.6×10⁶J energy છે, power નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Unit conversion changes numerical value while preserving the physical quantity by multiplying factors equal to one.

Explanation and use

  • 1ft=0.3048m; 1lbm=0.45359237kg; 1h=3600s; 1ft³=0.0283168466m³.Cube a length conversion for volume.
  • 1bar=10⁵Pa; 1atm=101325Pa; 1torr=101325/760Pa; 1kgf/cm²=98066.5Pa.1Btu≈1055.06J; mechanical1hp≈745.7W; 1lbf·ft≈1.35582J.
  • T(K)=t(°C)+273.15; t(°F)=1.8t(°C)+32.Absolute T(°R)=1.8T(K).For intervals, ΔK=Δ°C and Δ°F=1.8Δ°C; do not add offsets to differences.
  • Every additive term in an equation must have the same dimensions.Dimensional correctness is necessary but does not prove numerical constants or physical assumptions correct.

એક સમાન conversion factorsથી physical quantity જાળવી numerical value બદલવી એટલે unit conversion.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • 1ft=0.3048m; 1lbm=0.45359237kg; 1h=3600s; 1ft³=0.0283168466m³.Volumeમાં length factor cube કરો.
  • 1bar=10⁵Pa; 1atm=101325Pa; 1torr=101325/760Pa; 1kgf/cm²=98066.5Pa.1Btu≈1055.06J; mechanical1hp≈745.7W; 1lbf·ft≈1.35582J.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

ρ=62.4lbm/ft³; 1lbm=0.45359237kg; 1ft=0.3048m.

To find

Convert density to SI.

Formula / necessary assumptions

ρSI=ρFPS×(kg/lbm)/(m/ft)³.

Calculation

  1. 1ft³=(0.3048)³m³=0.0283168466m³.
  2. ρ=62.4×0.45359237/0.0283168466=999.552kg/m³.

Final answer

ρ≈999.55kg/m³.

Check

Density needs the cube of length conversion, not a single0.3048 factor.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

ρ=62.4lbm/ft³; 1lbm=0.45359237kg; 1ft=0.3048m.

શું શોધવું

Density SIમાં ફેરવો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

ρSI=ρFPS×(kg/lbm)/(m/ft)³.

ગણતરી

  1. 1ft³=(0.3048)³m³=0.0283168466m³.
  2. ρ=62.4×0.45359237/0.0283168466=999.552kg/m³.

અંતિમ જવાબ

ρ≈999.55kg/m³.

ચકાસણી

Densityમાં length conversion cube થાય, માત્ર0.3048 નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

m=20kg; a=3m/s²; A=0.005m².

To find

Find force and pressure.

Formula / necessary assumptions

F=ma; P=F/A.

Calculation

  1. F=20×3=60N.
  2. P=60/0.005=12000Pa=12kPa.

Final answer

F=60N; P=12kPa.

Check

N/m²=Pa; smaller area gives greater pressure for the same force.

આપેલી માહિતી

m=20kg; a=3m/s²; A=0.005m².

શું શોધવું

Force તથા pressure શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

F=ma; P=F/A.

ગણતરી

  1. F=20×3=60N.
  2. P=60/0.005=12000Pa=12kPa.

અંતિમ જવાબ

F=60N; P=12kPa.

ચકાસણી

N/m²=Pa; સમાન forceમાં ઓછી areaથી વધુ pressure.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

F=500N; s=12m; t=30s.

To find

Find work and average power; convert work to kWh.

Formula / necessary assumptions

W=Fs; P=W/t; 1kWh=3.6×10⁶J.

Calculation

  1. W=500×12=6000J.
  2. P=6000/30=200W=0.2kW.
  3. W=6000/(3.6×10⁶)=0.0016667kWh.

Final answer

W=6kJ=0.0016667kWh; P=200W.

Check

Power is not kWh; 0.2kW×(30/3600)h reproduces the energy.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

F=500N; s=12m; t=30s.

શું શોધવું

Work/average power તથા workનું kWh શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

W=Fs; P=W/t; 1kWh=3.6×10⁶J.

ગણતરી

  1. W=500×12=6000J.
  2. P=6000/30=200W=0.2kW.
  3. W=6000/(3.6×10⁶)=0.0016667kWh.

અંતિમ જવાબ

W=6kJ=0.0016667kWh; P=200W.

ચકાસણી

Power kWh નથી; 0.2kW×(30/3600)hથી એ જ energy મળે.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

t=50°C; pressure=2bar absolute; temperature rise=20°C.

To find

Convert to K, °F, kPa and Pa; convert the temperature interval.

Formula / necessary assumptions

T=t+273.15; °F=1.8t+32; 1bar=10⁵Pa; Δ°F=1.8Δ°C.

Calculation

  1. T=50+273.15=323.15K; °F=1.8×50+32=122°F.
  2. 2bar=200kPa=200000Pa.
  3. ΔT=20K=36°F interval.

Final answer

323.15K; 122°F; 200kPa; ΔT=20K=36°F.

Check

The32-degree offset applies to a reading, not an interval.

ગણતરી

  1. T=50+273.15=323.15K; °F=1.8×50+32=122°F.
  2. 2bar=200kPa=200000Pa.
  3. ΔT=20K=36°F interval.

અંતિમ જવાબ

ચકાસણી

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Proposed relation P=ρu², where P is pressure.

To find

Test dimensional consistency.

Formula / necessary assumptions

[ρ]=ML⁻³; [u]=LT⁻¹.

Calculation

  1. [ρu²]=(ML⁻³)(L²T⁻²)=ML⁻¹T⁻².
  2. [P]=[force]/[area]=(MLT⁻²)/L²=ML⁻¹T⁻².

Final answer

The dimensions agree; the relation may still need a coefficient and physical assumptions.

Check

Dimensional agreement is necessary, not proof of a physical law.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

Proposed relation P=ρu², P pressure છે.

શું શોધવું

Dimensional consistency તપાસો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

[ρ]=ML⁻³; [u]=LT⁻¹.

ગણતરી

  1. [ρu²]=(ML⁻³)(L²T⁻²)=ML⁻¹T⁻².
  2. [P]=[force]/[area]=(MLT⁻²)/L²=ML⁻¹T⁻².

અંતિમ જવાબ

Dimensions મળે છે; છતાં coefficient/physical assumptions જરૂરી હોઈ શકે.

ચકાસણી

Dimensional agreement જરૂરી છે, physical lawનો પુરાવો નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

m=32.174lbm; a=2ft/s²; gc=32.174lbm·ft/(lbf·s²).

To find

Find force in lbf and approximate newtons.

Formula / necessary assumptions

F=ma/gc; 1lbf=4.4482216N.

Calculation

  1. F=32.174×2/32.174=2lbf.
  2. F=2×4.4482216=8.89644N.

Final answer

F=2lbf≈8.8964N.

Check

Using F=ma without gc would give poundals in absolute FPS, not lbf.

Force lbf તથા approximate Nમાં શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

F=ma/gc; 1lbf=4.4482216N.

  2. F=2×4.4482216=8.89644N.
